messages:
anya: Quick sync — I want to standardize what we show on the new perf dashboard for latency/cost signals. Specifically: TTFT, tokens/sec, and p95 latency. Can folks confirm the definitions we're using so dashboards + alerts match?

nate: +1. we still have two variants of TTFT in dashboards (startup vs steady-state). which do you mean? :eyes:

anya: I mean 'TTFT (cold-start)' = time from request arrival to first token sent when no KV cache exists; and 'TTFT (warm)' = first token with cache warm. We should show both as separate panels.

miguel: agree. For alerting, we should only use warm TTFT p95 to avoid noisy alerts from rare cold starts.

chen: question — how are we computing tok/s on the dashboard? per-request instantaneous rate or aggregated?

olivia: we aggregate at 1m windows, then compute weighted average by request count. that avoids skew from tiny fast requests.

anya: ok good. I'll add that to the doc. Also proposal for p95 latency: include both 'generation p95' (time to produce last token) and 'first-token p95' (time to first token). Both over 5m and 1h windows.

nate: can we add PromQL snippets so support can cross-check raw queries?

anya: sure. example for warm first-token p95: ```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(req_first_token_seconds_bucket{cache="warm"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```

miguel: hmm that histogram_quantile will be noisy per-model. maybe do `by (model, region)` and then rollup on the dashboard with a selector.

chen: perf-bot ran a quick baseline run earlier and flagged a regression for model-x. perf-bot: "baseline run 2026-03-14: model-x warm-first-token p95 increased 18% vs last week"

perf-bot: INFO: baseline job #8421 completed. diffs -> https://dash.redwood.ai/r/perf-baselines/8421 :warning:

olivia: thanks perf-bot. miguel, nate — can you take a look at the profiler traces linked in the run? I added a short summary in the baseline note.

miguel: putting PR up now to add the revised metric definitions to the dashboard and the README. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/419 :pr:

nate: i'll review the PR today. quick ask: add a small widget that shows cold-start ratio (cold requests / total) as a %, since that will explain spikes in cold TTFT.

anya: added to the PR description. action items: 1) miguel update dashboard panels & add model/region rollup 2) chen verify PromQL across clusters 3) nate review PR + add cold-start ratio widget 4) olivia notify support once dashboards are live.

chen: I ran the PromQL across prod and eu regions — small dialect differences in labels. will open a tiny helper to normalize label sets before we feed to the dashboard.

olivia: noted — will message support to hold off alerting until we flip the new panels live.

nate: LGTM. also, for the alert thresholds: let's set warm-first-token p95 threshold = 1.5x baseline (rolling 14d median) to start, then tune.

anya: perfect. I'll follow up with a short doc and link it here. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

miguel: quick follow — should we surface tok/s as both per-request and overall throughput? ops wants per-request maximum so they can detect outliers.

anya: yes — add both. per-request peak (95th) and cluster-level aggregate.

perf-bot: REMINDER: dashboard deployment job #256 scheduled at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. If you want to block, comment on PR 419 before EOD.

nate: noted. blocking comments if any by EOD.

anya: thread summary pinned: definitions agreed, PR 419 is the change, perf-bot deployment tomorrow, action owners assigned.

olivia: thanks all. will prepare support message once deployed.

miguel: done for now. ping if regressions show up after deploy.
